i01.english: A compact solar microinverter with electrical connectors.
i01.chinese: 带电气连接接口的小型太阳能微型逆变器。
i01.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i01.assessment: Only e003/e007/e011 combine source-confirmed microinverter class with a compact enclosure and visible electrical cable interfaces. Larger inverter, UPS, charge-controller, distribution and transformer devices are different classes.

i02.english: A solar inverter mounted on a wall, with its casing closed.
i02.chinese: 安装在墙上、外壳闭合的太阳能逆变器。
i02.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i02.assessment: e004/e005/e008/e009/e014 show closed inverter casings mounted on vertical wall/wooden mounting surfaces. e002 is a supported freestanding central cabinet; e003/e007/e011 are rail/handheld/isolated microinverters; e012 is open; e001 is a charge controller.
i02.nonblocking_wording_boundary: e014 is on a wooden mounting panel/wall under a roof. The gallery convention treats that as a wall mounting surface; the image does not prove a closed building wall.

i03.english: An open solar inverter showing circuit boards and blue capacitors.
i03.chinese: 打开外壳后露出电路板和蓝色电容的太阳能逆变器。
i03.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i03.assessment: Only e012 visibly combines an opened inverter enclosure, circuit boards and blue cylindrical capacitors. The open distribution/control cabinets have breakers/terminals/wiring and are not inverter interiors.

i04.english: Solar inverters installed below or behind photovoltaic panels.
i04.chinese: 安装在光伏板下方或背面的太阳能逆变器。
i04.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i04.assessment: e002/e006/e010 show source-confirmed inverters installed below or behind visible photovoltaic-panel backs/array structures. e003 is explicitly photographed before its panel is placed; e007 is handheld, not installed; e011 is isolated, not installed; e036–e040 lack distinct visible inverters.

i05.english: An open electrical distribution or control cabinet with visible wiring.
i05.chinese: 打开柜门后能看到接线的电气配电柜或控制柜。
i05.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i05.assessment: e015/e017/e018/e019/e022 expose control/distribution breaker/PLC/terminal wiring. e012 is an inverter interior, not a distribution/control cabinet. e016 has closed transparent protective covers and no exposed internal wiring; e020 is closed; e021 has switchgear cabinet fronts rather than an open wired cabinet; e034 is a closed network rack.
i05.nonblocking_wording_boundary: Chinese refers to opening the cabinet door; for cropped e017/e019/e022, the positive criterion is exposed distribution/control internals, not a door visible inside the frame. English open cabinet has the same intended open-state meaning.

i06.english: An aisle between rows of industrial electrical switchgear cabinets.
i06.chinese: 成排工业电气开关柜之间的通道。
i06.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i06.assessment: Only e021 shows the required aisle between rows of industrial electrical switchgear. e031 is a UPS cabinet row with a different source-confirmed function; isolated/open cabinets and outdoor equipment groups lack the stated aisle/class combination.

i07.english: An outdoor power transformer with visible bushings or cooling fins.
i07.chinese: 能看到套管或散热片的室外电力变压器。
i07.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i07.assessment: e025–e029 visibly expose transformer bushings and/or radiator fins. e023 and e024 are transformer enclosures with ventilation grilles rather than exposed bushings/radiator fins, and remain hard negatives for the strict attribute wording. Other finned enclosures in the gallery are inverter housings, not outdoor power transformers.

i08.english: A UPS battery backup power supply for computers or servers.
i08.chinese: 给电脑或服务器提供断电备用电源的 UPS 不间断电源。
i08.bilingual_equivalence: Acceptable semantic match for the documented binary relevance rule.
i08.assessment: e030–e035 are source-confirmed UPS devices or UPS installations, including a datacenter row and a UPS inside a server rack. Inverter/charge-controller/distribution devices are not computer/server UPS positives.
